intuition: The best future choice depends on whether the previous day ended holding, sold, or resting.

brute_force.approach: Recursively choose to buy, sell, or wait while tracking whether a cooldown day is required.

optimal.approach: Track hold, sold, and rest profits with constant-size rolling state; only rest may transition to buying.

edge_cases: One price provides no completed transaction.
After selling, the next day must pass before another purchase.
